name: check
title: Mantis check
description: A self-check an AI agent runs inside its app after changing UI: lists every place the code stepped outside Mantis (stock Tailwind colors, raw color values, bracket values where a token or scale step exists, numeric durations and stock blur sizes, source-layer tokens, Radix habits, another icon set, a theme that is not wired in), each with the fix to write. One file with no dependencies, generated from the token source.
docs: Installed to scripts/mantis-check.mjs. Run `node scripts/mantis-check.mjs` from the app root after every UI change and clear every finding; `--json` for tools, `--dir <path>` to narrow, `--include-ui` to also scan the installed primitives and Mantis's own blocks, `--css <entry>` if the Tailwind entry is not app/globals.css, `--quiet` for the summary line only. Exit code 1 means something was found. A deliberate exception takes a comment with a reason: `// mantis-check: allow raw-color — the partner's logo color`. Re-run `npx shadcn@latest add @mantis/check --overwrite` after each Mantis release.
